comments: This listing is for the free scan only, at https://webmax.co/audit. It is a free, automated, partial check of one public page on any website. It will not catch everything a person would, and it is not a full audit. The Email address field on the scan is optional. It runs in any modern web browser.
features: WebMax's own scanner, built on open-source testing rules. It runs a free, automated, partial check of one public page on any website and identifies issues an automated tool can find. You can choose WCAG level AA or AAA. It will not catch everything a person would, and it is not a full audit. Email is optional.
title: WebMax Free Accessibility Scan
